integrity: All 216 three-agent profiles and all unilateral false reports are checked exactly. Two independent PS implementations agree on every profile, and the complete event set is independently reduced to two symmetry classes with a universal utility-gain formula.
scientific_limitations: The complete census is restricted to three agents and three objects with strict preferences. Full-strategyproofness failure is utility-dependent because no false report strictly stochastically dominates the truthful PS lottery.
title: Complete three-agent strategyproofness boundary for probabilistic serial
